assets.name: filter
assets.prompt: Pixel art game asset on pure solid black background #000000, no text, no labels, no scenery, no shadows, no gradients, no glow. Exactly THREE isolated SIDE VIEW microscopic creatures arranged left to right in three equal columns, small juvenile then medium adult then elaborate evolved adult. All three share a single consistent identity. Crisp blocky square pixels, limited palette exclusively warm ivory #F3EDDD, pale mauve #D2B7DF, plum #6F527B, mint #A9CDB1, amber #E5B56B. Plenty of pure black padding between the three creatures. Each creature centered in its column. Game sprite concept sheet, readable at 48 pixels tall. a beautiful imaginary aquatic FILTER FEEDER microfauna, delicate oval translucent shell, paired feathery mint feeding fans on each side, ivory segmented body and lavender organs, an elegant living sieve.
